profile.headline: Software Engineer II at D.A. Davidson Companies
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience working in the software industry, ranging from small handheld games, full-scale application suites, and recently an internal business web application used at Raytheon.

I am highly adaptable to new tools and technologies and changing requirements.  I've worked on multiple teams with various project lengths, various sizes, all focused on bringing a quality product to fruition.  I bring to the table not only my software development experience but also team-oriented, value engineering experience that focuses on delivering value-centric features early so that management can make informed decisions.  

Languages:  C#, C++, C, TypeScript, CSS/HTML, SQL
Platforms: Windows XP/7/10/11, WindowsCE, NintendoDS, Web
Frameworks: .NET Framework 2.0+, .NET Core 6
RDMS: SQL Server 2008+
Source Control:  TFS, Azure DevOps, BitBucket, GitHub

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a member of the Software Development Apps Team, my primary responsibilities include designing and developing in-house financial applications.

Responsibilities:
•	Develop the Trading Orders Automation web service.  The web service  is built on Microsoft’s tech stack (.NET Framework 4.6.1, C#, WCF, MS SQL)
•	Enhance the DADCO.NET framework for D.A. Davidson’s .NET applications.  This framework is used for desktop and web-based applications.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Web Services · Unit Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
At Raytheon, I'm part of a small agile team working with multiple teams on developing customized web entry forms utilizing a combination of the Serenity Web Business Application Framework, ASP.NET MVC, TypeScript, SQL, CSS, HTML5, jQuery, Dapper, and Bootstrap.

From these web entry forms, the information is passed to custom dashboards created for each customer's needs.  Here they can track and analyze what they need to know within minutes.  

As more and more of these teams are working with us, we are able to provide a level of collaboration that was previously never available by providing a singular source of information rather than multiple, unconnected sources.

The team runs on a 2-week sprint cycle, fully embracing the SCRUM methodology for agile development with releases occurring at the end of each sprint.
positions.insights: Skills: LESS (Stylesheet Language) · .NET Framework · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery · Bitbucket · Agile Environment · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Team Foundation Server · Scrum · Communication · Relational Databases · Analytical Skills · C# · HTML5 · TypeScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET MVC · Requirements Analysis · Jira · Serenity Web Business Application Framework · Git · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I was a Windows/Windows Embedded Application Developer and, from 2013 to 2016, ScrumMaster for the ProVision Machine Guidance team.  My team and I worked using the Microsoft .NET Framework in a Domain Driven Design/N-Tier architecture.

Responsibilities include: 
- Developing new software modules and extending existing ones
- Conducting POCs (Proof of Concepts)
- Developing unit tests, automation tests to improve code quality and software reliability
- Conducting code reviews on code submissions to the ProVision application
- Analyzing new feature requirements and providing technical descriptions on software application design updates and work estimates  
- Working with the Product Specialist to define the scope and business requirements of new features 
- Working with the Testing Engineer to create actionable test cases to test the new feature.
- Mentoring junior engineers
- Assisting with manual software testing to meet release timeline
- Support existing product functionalities by fixing product defects.

ScrumMaster responsibilities included: 
- Removing impediments for my team members.
- Enforcing product development process.
- Guiding the Release Planning, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospective, Daily Stand-up, and Sprint Grooming meetings.
- Tracking sprint progress, and participating in intra-team and upper management communication meetings.
